title: Fridolin brain.json
description: A brain's manifest, version 1, in the brain's own folder, as docs/BRAINS.md describes it; config.json's brain_dirs[].approved holds the copy you approved. Fields are added without a new version; one renamed, removed or given another meaning comes with one.

version.description: The version of the manifest; absent is 1.

id.description: Stable: history, the sandbox profile and credential files go by it.

disallowed_tools.description: Left out, the brain gets the global list; [] allows every tool.

prompt_file.description: Relative to the brain's folder, and inside it. Default brain-prompt.md.

targets.description: Which backup targets get the folder: "cloud" (unset: true) and "node:<target>" of vault.targets (unset: false).

node_only.description: Paths, in exclude's syntax, that never go to the cloud but go to the node targets the brain chooses.

role.description: "core" for the one brain that may reach the others through its grants; left out for a sub-brain.

grants.description: Only on the core brain: what it may do with each other brain, by that brain's id. The brain must be configured and not the core brain itself.

memory.description: The memory index (docs/BRAINS.md, Memory). Left out: nothing recalled, no consolidation.

inject.description: Put the owner's messages and the brain's own notes that match a new message into its prompt, with their sources. Default false.

top_k.description: The most chunks a prompt gets; 0 is the default, 5.

max_chars.description: The most characters of them in all; 0 is the default, 2000.

consolidate.description: When the brain runs skills/memory-consolidation.md: "weekly sun 18:00" or "daily 07:00", in the bridge's time zone; empty never.

schedules.description: The brain's scheduled agents (docs/BRAINS.md, Scheduled agents). A change the brain makes itself waits for your approval, like any change to brain.json.

name.description: The agent's name, unique in the brain.

when.description: "every 6h", "daily 07:00", "weekly mon 09:00" or a cron expression ("cron 0 7 * * 1-5"), in the bridge's time zone.

enabled.description: Run on the schedule. Default true; Run now works either way.

description.description: What it is for, one line.

prompt.description: The task, inline. At most one of prompt, prompt_file, template and command; none is the file schedules/<name>.md.

prompt_file.description: A file in the brain's folder that holds the task.

template.description: A built-in task: memory-consolidation, morning-briefing, code-review-security, code-review-bugs, code-review-simplify.

command.description: A program the bridge runs on a node through its exec capability, instead of a brain run.

argv.description: The program and its arguments; no shell.

dir.description: The working directory on the node.

vars.description: Fill {{name}} in the template or prompt file.

report.description: Where the result goes: always to the chat, only when worth reporting (the default), or nowhere (kept in the history and log).

chat.description: The chat the result goes to, a JID; default the brain's reply chat.

risk.description: The run's risk budget; default write.

disallowed_tools.description: Left out, the brain's list; [] allows every tool.

timeout_minutes.description: Stop a run that takes longer; 0 is run_timeout_minutes, which it can only shorten.

missed.description: A run that fell due while the bridge was down: run once on start (the default) or skip it.

jitter_minutes.description: Spread the runs by a fixed offset within this many minutes; left out, schedules.jitter_minutes.

preapproved.description: Steps approved together with the schedule, which its runs take without asking.

secrets.description: What the bridge hands these runs and no other: github is GH_TOKEN from FRIDOLIN_GITHUB_TOKEN.
